text: FOLLOW-UP COMMIT on claude/activation-fixes-20260908: edf4fdf75f22eaf7688ba7f17956ff1f55cb349c (tests only; no runtime change since 6af2474). It corrects my over-broad 'adds nothing' claim: the retry test now asserts the exact residual of a losing new-resource upload — no second version, winner's versionId+sha returned, ONE orphan zero-version resource row and ONE orphan private object present and unpublishable, partner library empty — and adds a test that a loser with different bytes cannot alter the winner (hash/filename/state unchanged; winner reviews, publishes and delivers its own bytes). 119/119 in server/research/resource-hub, tsc 0. Integrate the branch at edf4fdf75f22eaf7688ba7f17956ff1f55cb349c (both commits), not 6af2474 alone. Open finding for A/B, NOT fixed here by design (no hurried cleanup): the orphan zero-version resource row from a lost new-resource race still appears in listAdmin/listResources as an empty resource; decide whether admin listing should hide zero-version resources or whether an operator-visible orphan is acceptable — that is a listing-semantics decision, not part of these two blockers.
